sn11.20:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn11.20:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
sn11.20:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sakko devānamindo mātalisaṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi:
sn11.20:1.4: yojehi samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyāti.
sn11.20:1.5: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave, mātali saṅgāhako sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā sakkassa devānamindassa paṭivedesi:
sn11.20:1.6: yutto kho te mārisa, sahassayutto ājaññaratho,
sn11.20:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ namassati.
sn11.20:1.9: atha kho bhikkhave mātali saṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
